rules.title: Santa Ana Rent Increase Cap
rules.requirement: Landlords can only raise rent by a certain amount each year. The increase cannot be more than 3% of current rent or 80% of the Consumer Price Index (CPI) change, whichever is less.
rules.citation: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: The increase cannot be more than 3% of your current rent or 80% of the Consumer Price Index (CPI) change, whichever is less.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to all rental units in Santa Ana, CA

rules.title: Santa Ana Just Cause Eviction Requirement
rules.requirement: Landlords must have a valid reason to evict tenants. Valid reasons include non-payment of rent, breaking the lease, or if the landlord wants to move into the property themselves.
rules.citation: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: Your landlord must have a valid reason to evict you. This could be for not paying rent, breaking the lease, or if the landlord wants to move into the property themselves.
rules.key_value: Valid reasons: non-payment, lease breach, landlord move-in
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to all rental units in Santa Ana, CA

rules.title: Santa Ana Relocation Assistance for Evictions
rules.requirement: If landlords evict tenants for certain reasons, landlords might have to help pay for moving costs.
rules.citation: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: If your landlord evicts you for certain reasons, they might have to help pay for your moving costs.
rules.key_value: Moving cost assistance conditional on eviction reason
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies when landlord evicts tenant for certain enumerated reasons (specific triggering reasons not detailed in source)
rules.conflict_note: Source uses conditional language 'might have to' and references 'certain reasons' without specifying which eviction grounds trigger relocation assistance; full enumeration requires review of operative ordinance text
